title: DcatResourceBase
description:
Base interface for DCAT catalogued resources without JSON-LD context.
This is the context-free variant of IDcatResource, intended for embedding
resources inline within other objects where the context is provided by the enclosing document.

@type.description:
The type of the resource.
Typically "Catalog", "Dataset", "DataService", "DatasetSeries", or the base "Resource".

@id.description: The unique identifier for the resource.

dcterms:title.description: A name given to the resource.

dcterms:description.description: A free-text account of the resource.

dcterms:identifier.description: A unique identifier of the resource.

dcterms:issued.description: Date of formal issuance (publication) of the resource.

dcterms:modified.description: Most recent date on which the resource was changed, updated or modified.

dcterms:publisher.description: An entity responsible for making the resource available.

dcterms:creator.description: An entity responsible for producing the resource.

dcterms:accessRights.description: Information about who can access the resource or an indication of its security status.

dcterms:license.description: A legal document under which the resource is made available.

dcterms:rights.description: Information about rights held in and over the resource.

dcterms:conformsTo.description: An established standard to which the resource conforms.

dcterms:type.description: The nature or genre of the resource.

dcat:contactPoint.description: Relevant contact information for the catalogued resource.

dcat:keyword.description: A keyword or tag describing the resource.

dcat:theme.description: A main category of the resource. A resource can have multiple themes.

dcat:landingPage.description: A Web page that can be navigated to gain access to the resource.

dcat:qualifiedRelation.description: Link to a description of a relationship with another resource.

odrl:hasPolicy.description: An ODRL conformant policy expressing the rights associated with the resource.

@type.description:
The type of policy.
Must be one of: "Set", "Offer", "Agreement"

uid.description:
The unique identifier for the policy.
Must be an IRI.

profile.description:
The profile(s) this policy conforms to.
IRIs identifying the ODRL Profile(s).

assigner.description:
The assigner of the policy.
Applies to all rules unless overridden at rule level.

assignee.description:
The assignee of the policy.
Applies to all rules unless overridden at rule level.

target.description: The target asset for the rule.

action.description: The action associated with the rule.

inheritFrom.description:
The parent policy(ies) this policy inherits from.
IRIs identifying the parent Policy(ies).

conflict.description:
The conflict resolution strategy.
- perm: Permissions override Prohibitions
- prohibit: Prohibitions override Permissions
- invalid: Policy is void if conflicts exist (default)

permission.description:
The permissions in the policy.
At least one of permission, prohibition, or obligation must be present.

prohibition.description:
The prohibitions in the policy.
At least one of permission, prohibition, or obligation must be present.

obligation.description:
The obligations in the policy.
At least one of permission, prohibition, or obligation must be present.

@context.description:
The context for the policy.
Must include "https://www.w3.org/ns/odrl.jsonld"

odrl:hasPolicy.$comment: Inlined utility base type OdrlPolicy so utility transformations can operate on concrete properties instead of a $ref.
